mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (code, name, scope, is_system) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{scope}, #{isSystem})
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, scope = #{scope} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff_account_platform_role sapr JOIN platform_role pr ON pr.id = sapr.platform_role_id JOIN role r ON r.code = pr.code WHERE r.id = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_member_role dmr JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id JOIN role r ON r.code = dr.code WHERE r.id = #{roleId}
mapper.delete: DELETE dmr FROM domain_member_role dmr JOIN domain_member dm ON dm.id = dmr.domain_member_id WHERE dm.staff_account_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff_account_platform_role (staff_account_id, platform_role_id, created_at) SELECT #{userId}, pr.id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM platform_role pr JOIN role r ON r.code = pr.code WHERE r.id = #{roleId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE created_at = VALUES(created_at)
INSERT INTO iam_role_binding (user_id, role_id, binding_scope, business_domain_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, 'global', NULL, 1)
INSERT INTO iam_role_binding (user_id, role_id, binding_scope, business_domain_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, 'domain', #{businessDomainId}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT code FROM ( SELECT pr.code AS code FROM staff_account_platform_role sapr JOIN platform_role pr ON pr.id = sapr.platform_role_id WHERE sapr.staff_account_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT dr.code AS code FROM domain_member dm JOIN domain_member_role dmr ON dmr.domain_member_id = dm.id JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id WHERE dm.staff_account_id = #{userId} AND dm.status = 'active' AND dm.deleted_at IS NULL ) roles ORDER BY code

SELECT DISTINCT code FROM ( SELECT pr.code AS code FROM staff_account_platform_role sapr JOIN platform_role pr ON pr.id = sapr.platform_role_id WHERE sapr.staff_account_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT dr.code AS code FROM domain_member dm JOIN domain_member_role dmr ON dmr.domain_member_id = dm.id JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id WHERE dm.staff_account_id = #{userId} AND dm.status = 'active' AND dm.deleted_at IS NULL ) roles

SELECT DISTINCT r.code FROM role r JOIN ( SELECT pr.code AS code FROM staff_account_platform_role sapr JOIN platform_role pr ON pr.id = sapr.platform_role_id WHERE sapr.staff_account_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT dr.code AS code FROM domain_member dm JOIN domain_member_role dmr ON dmr.domain_member_id = dm.id JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id WHERE dm.staff_account_id = #{userId} AND dm.status = 'active' AND dm.deleted_at IS NULL UNION SELECT r2.code AS code FROM customer_account ca JOIN domain_customer dc ON dc.customer_account_id = ca.id AND dc.status = 'active' AND dc.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN role r2 ON r2.code = 'customer' AND r2.scope = 'domain' WHERE ca.id = #{userId} ) ur ON ur.code = r.code JOIN iam_role_resource irr ON irr.role_id = r.id JOIN iam_resource ir ON ir.id = irr.resource_id WHERE ir.status = 1 AND (ir.client_scope = #{clientCode} OR ir.client_scope = 'all')
SELECT DISTINCT business_domain_id FROM domain_member WHERE staff_account_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY business_domain_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) FROM staff_account_platform_role sapr JOIN platform_role pr ON pr.id = sapr.platform_role_id JOIN staff_account sa ON sa.id = sapr.staff_account_id WHERE pr.code = #{roleCode} AND sapr.staff_account_id <> #{userId} AND sa.status = 'active' AND sa.employment_status <> 'offboarded'
SELECT id, code, name FROM business_domain ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.code, d.name FROM domain_member dm JOIN domain_member_role dmr ON dmr.domain_member_id = dm.id JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id JOIN business_domain d ON d.id = dm.business_domain_id WHERE dm.staff_account_id = #{userId} AND dm.deleted_at IS NULL AND dr.code IN #{code} ORDER BY d.id
